text: Let me give you concrete reason why v20 is wrong. as it stands, v20s approach was implemented, and i never had session rewind capability. infact, i never even had leave the route and come back to undo history, i barely had hotreload history. now, while you may look at see that all the capability to rewind was made, none of it was ever exposed to me properly. so effectively i now see it as the wrong approach since i learned how to work around it anyways
resolution: Recorded the user's concrete V20 correction rationale in cart/hmsc-workspace-mock/DESIGN_INTAKE.md. Added that V20's persistent history approach was implemented but never gave the user usable session rewind, reliable route-leave/return undo, or meaningful hot-reload history; internal rewind capability that is not exposed through the product does not count as success. Captured the design conclusion that the new eventbus/autosave/backup approach should prioritize observable recoverable editor behavior over invisible total-history promises, and that any future history/recovery must be a clear user-facing workflow. No implementation changes were made; this should later be reconciled as a formal V20 amendment so oracle output stops privileging the old model.
